description: This file contains platform-specific functions and logic for upgrading firmware images on different hardware boards within an embedded Linux environment (likely OpenWrt). It defines functions to check image validity and perform upgrade procedures based on the board type.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the provided image is valid for the platform; always returns success in this implementation.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process based on the detected board name, using different upgrade strategies and environment settings.
